bias: healthier — lean proteins, vegetables, grilled/baked/sautéed over fried/creamy-heavy

warm-steak-kale.name: Warm Steak, Kale & Sweet Potato Salad
warm-steak-kale.pitch: Seared garlic-thyme steak over massaged kale with browned sweet potato — high protein, veggie-forward, light balsamic finish.
ingredients: Olive oil, cooking oil, butter, salt, pepper
steps: Dice sweet potato; microwave with half the garlic powder, salt, pepper, and butter until tender (~6–7 min).
Massage kale with olive oil until tender.
Slice steak thin; sear with thyme and remaining garlic powder 3–6 min. Brown sweet potato briefly in the pan.
Toss kale with sweet potato, Parmesan, and dressing; top with steak, pecans, and cranberries.

sesame-ginger-steak.name: Sesame Ginger Steak Salad
sesame-ginger-steak.pitch: Quick seared steak over mixed greens with cucumber and tomato — carb-conscious, no heavy cream sauces.
ingredients: Olive oil, cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Slice cucumber and halve tomatoes; quarter lime.
Slice steak; season with sesame ginger crunch. Sear 3–5 min; finish with garlic-ginger paste, half the chili sauce, and lime juice.
Whisk vinegar, remaining chili sauce, olive oil, and lime for dressing.
Toss greens, cucumber, and tomatoes; top with steak, crispy onions, and peanuts.

steak-nicoise.name: Steak Niçoise Salad
steak-nicoise.pitch: Provençal steak salad with green beans, potatoes, tomatoes, and olives — lighter bistro plate, vinaigrette over creamy sauces.
ingredients: Olive oil, cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Microwave potatoes with half the garlic herb butter until tender.
Microwave green beans until tender; chop lettuce and olives.
Season steak with herbes de Provence; sear 3–6 min per side; rest.
Whisk vinegar, mustard, remaining herbs, and olive oil; toss with lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, and olives. Slice steak on top.

italian-steak-broccoli.name: Italian-Style Steak & Roasted Baby Broccoli
italian-steak-broccoli.pitch: Balsamic-marinated seared steak with roasted baby broccoli and arugula panzanella — veggie-heavy, sodium-smart.
ingredients: Olive oil, cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Roast baby broccoli and torn ciabatta at 425°F until tender/crisp (~12–15 min).
Marinate steak in balsamic, rosemary, and olive oil.
Whisk sherry vinaigrette; toss cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and croutons.
Sear steak 5–7 min per side; rest and slice. Serve with broccoli and arugula panzanella; grate Parmesan over.

tuscan-chicken-succotash.name: Tuscan Chicken & Tomato-Basil Succotash
tuscan-chicken-succotash.pitch: Oven-roasted spice-rubbed chicken over blistered zucchini, corn, pepper, and tomatoes — high protein, carb-conscious, light lemon aioli.
ingredients: 24 oz chicken cutlets (kit size; use ~10–12 oz for 2)
Olive oil, cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Season chicken with Tuscan spice; roast at 425°F until cooked through (~15–18 min).
Sauté zucchini and tomatoes until blistered; add scallion whites, pepper, and corn; finish with basil paste.
Mix lemon zest, mayo, garlic powder, and lemon juice for aioli.
Plate succotash, top with chicken and aioli; garnish with scallion greens.

chicken-veggie-feta.name: Roasted Chicken, Potatoes & Veggie-Feta Jumble
chicken-veggie-feta.pitch: Sheet-pan roasted chicken with Mediterranean potatoes and zucchini–carrot–onion jumble finished with feta — GLP-1 friendly, ~590 kcal.
steps: Toss potatoes with oil, garlic powder, and Mediterranean spice; toss carrots, zucchini, and onion with oil. Roast 5 min.
Season chicken with fry seasoning; roast on a second sheet until done (~18–22 min) while veggies finish.
Toss roasted veggies with feta; slice chicken.
Plate chicken with veggie jumble and potatoes.

spiced-chicken-yogurt.name: Spiced Chicken Cutlets with Roasted Vegetables & Lemon Yogurt Sauce
spiced-chicken-yogurt.pitch: Shawarma-spiced cutlets with roasted veg and lemon yogurt — Calorie Smart / Mediterranean, yogurt sauce instead of cream.
ingredients: Sour cream or yogurt for sauce
steps: Roast potatoes, zucchini, and onion with spices until tender.
Season chicken with shawarma/Turkish spices; cook until done.
Stir lemon yogurt/sour cream sauce with garlic.
Serve chicken over roasted veg with yogurt sauce and a sprinkle of feta.

classic-roasted-salmon.name: Classic Roasted Salmon
classic-roasted-salmon.pitch: Oven-roasted salmon with green beans, burst tomatoes, and crispy potato rounds — ~560 kcal, omega-3s, no heavy cream sauce.
steps: Boil green beans briefly; boil potatoes until tender; drain.
Sauté tomatoes, then green beans and garlic with half the dill.
Roast salmon skin-side down at 425°F ~8–10 min.
Crush potato rounds and pan-crisp; finish with remaining dill. Plate salmon with veggies and potatoes.

soy-glazed-salmon-kale.name: Sweet Soy-Glazed Salmon & Kale Salad
soy-glazed-salmon-kale.pitch: Seared salmon over sesame kale–slaw salad with quick pickles — Protein Smart / Carb Smart, no fried sides.
ingredients: Olive oil, cooking oil, sugar, salt, pepper
steps: Sear salmon skin-side down until crisp; flip briefly; drizzle with sweet soy glaze.
Microwave onion and carrots with vinegar and sugar to quick-pickle.
Massage kale with oil; toss with coleslaw, pickling liquid, and sesame dressing.
Top salad with salmon, drained pickles, and peanuts.

cajun-sheet-salmon.name: Sheet Pan Cajun Salmon with Asparagus & Sweet Potato
cajun-sheet-salmon.pitch: One-pan Cajun-spiced salmon with roasted sweet potato and asparagus — baked not fried; light spiced yogurt/sour cream drizzle.
steps: Roast diced sweet potato at 450°F until nearly tender (~20–24 min).
Coat salmon with Cajun spice + sugar; roast with asparagus until fish is done and spears are tender.
Finish asparagus with lemon juice.
Mix sour cream with spice blend and a splash of water/hot sauce; drizzle over plated salmon and veggies.
